description: PC Jeweller Limited manufactures, sells, and trades in gold, diamond, silver articles, precious stone, and gold and diamond studded jewellery for men and women in India and internationally. It offers rings, earrings, pendants, chains, bracelets, nose pins, necklaces, and mangalsutra. It sells its jewellery through its retail showrooms, franchisee showrooms, and online. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in New Delhi, India.
